verdict: Yes, for a skilled cheesemaker. Cremeitalia from Mumbai pitched fresh Italian cheeses on Shark Tank India Season 2, but didn't get a deal. Restaurants and home cooks want fresh mozzarella and burrata made locally, but the cheeses have a short shelf life.
angle: Pizza and Italian food have created demand for fresh cheeses. Restaurants and hotels are steady buyers. Cold chain and consistent quality are essential.
